findings.title: Migration crashes with NoMethodError when embed_category or uncategorized_category_id setting is not in DB
findings.body: In `CreateEmbeddableHosts#change`, lines 9-11 run `execute("SELECT c.id FROM categories AS c INNER JOIN site_settings AS s ON s.value = c.name WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id'].to_i`. On any Discourse instance where `embed_category` was never modified from its default (or does not match an existing category name), the `PG::Result` has 0 rows, so `[0]` raises `IndexError: Index 0 is out of bounds` (or `NoMethodError: undefined method '[]' for nil:NilClass`), aborting the migration. The same problem exists on line 15 for `uncategorized_category_id` if that row is not present in `site_settings`. Check `cmd_tuples > 0` before indexing `[0]`.

findings.title: Migrated embeddable_hosts values are inserted without stripping scheme/path or SQL escaping
findings.body: The previous `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` implementation accepted entries in `embeddable_hosts` with `http://`/`https://` prefixes or trailing paths (as seen in the old specs). `CreateEmbeddableHosts` inserts each line verbatim via raw SQL (`INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`), bypassing `EmbeddableHost`'s `before_validation` hook that strips `^https?://` and `/.*$`. Because `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` later compares `lower(host)` against `uri.host` (hostname only), any existing host setting saved with a scheme or path will stop matching after migration, breaking embedding for those sites. In addition, `h` is interpolated directly into SQL without `quote`.

findings.title: before_validation raises NoMethodError when host is nil and does not normalize or compare port/case
findings.body: In `EmbeddableHost`: (1) `before_validation` calls `self.host.sub!(...)` unconditionally, which raises `NoMethodError: undefined method 'sub!' for nil:NilClass` when `EmbeddableHost.new` is validated with a `nil` `host` (e.g. missing param). (2) In `self.record_for_host(host)`, `host = uri.host` is not downcased (though `URI` usually downcases ASCII hosts) and strips any port (`uri.port`), whereas the validation regex on line 2 allows saving a host with `:port` (e.g. `example.com:8080`). A saved host with a port will never match `uri.host` in `where("lower(host) = ?", host)`.

findings.title: Topic#expandable_first_post? no longer checks if any EmbeddableHost exists, breaking spec
findings.body: `Topic#expandable_first_post?` was changed from `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? && SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` to `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?`. In `spec/models/topic_spec.rb:1403`, the test `it "is false if embeddable_host is blank"` only passes by accident because `SiteSetting.embed_truncate` defaults to `false` when no `before` block runs; if `embed_truncate` is `true` and a topic has a `TopicEmbed` record, `expandable_first_post?` now returns `true` even when no `EmbeddableHost` records exist.

findings.title: String.prototype.replace('_', '-') only replaces the first underscore
findings.body: In `basePath`, `type.replace('_', '-')` only replaces the first underscore in `type`. If an admin model name has more than one underscore (or if `Ember.String.dasherize(type)` was intended), `ADMIN_MODELS.indexOf(...)` will fail to match. Use `type.replace(/_/g, '-')` or `Ember.String.dasherize(type)`.

findings.title: category_fabricator.rb and embeddable_host_fabricator.rb contents are swapped
findings.body: `spec/fabricators/category_fabricator.rb` was overwritten to define `Fabricator(:embeddable_host)`, while the newly added `spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb` contains the `:category`, `:diff_category`, `:happy_category`, and `:private_category` fabricators. The two files have each other's contents.
